name: JW Marriott Hotel Madrid
insider_take: Madrid's most sophisticated address where royal elegance meets contemporary luxury in the heart of Spain's vibrant capital.
whats_special: This stunning property occupies a meticulously restored 1920s building that once housed the Spanish telephone company headquarters. The hotel's prime location on Sevilla Street places you within walking distance of the legendary Golden Triangle of Art - the Prado, Reina Sofía, and Thyssen museums. The rooftop terrace offers breathtaking panoramic views of Madrid's historic skyline, including the iconic Gran Vía.
pro_tip: Book a room on the higher floors facing Gran Vía for spectacular city views, and time your rooftop visit during golden hour for Instagram-worthy shots of Madrid's stunning architecture.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature restaurant helmed by renowned Spanish chef, featuring modern interpretations of traditional Castilian cuisine. Just steps away, explore the buzzing Barrio de las Letras (Literary Quarter) where Cervantes once lived, and indulge in authentic tapas crawls through the historic streets that have inspired writers for centuries.
pros: Prime location in Madrid's upscale Salamanca district
Luxurious accommodations with sophisticated design and premium amenities
Exceptional dining options including rooftop restaurant with panoramic city views
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Urban setting without traditional resort-style outdoor spaces
